item.description:

President Trump announced an alleged Russia-Ukraine energy ceasefire linked to a diesel deal, which Ukraine called false after further strikes. Ukraine hit a Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile maintenance base. Russia arrested a Japanese journalist on espionage charges. 75,767 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Defence Minister Herzog says a larger police force is needed to curb violent crime and settler attacks, and Israeli intelligence soldiers disclosed a policy shift that justifies civilian casualties in Gaza. Iran’s foreign minister called the Saudi Crown Prince to urge diplomatic solutions as Iran-backed militants continue pressure on the Crown Prince. item.description:
